title: Gospel Presenter
tagline: Delightfully simple presentation tool for churches. Free and open-source.
feature_presentations_desc: Build presentations with songs, Bible passages, images, and PDF slides. Save reusable templates and create new presentations in seconds.
feature_liveDisplay_desc: Show your presentation fullscreen on a connected screen or projector. Connect additional devices with a pairing code. Changes sync instantly to all connected displays.
feature_remoteControl_desc: Control the presentation from your phone or tablet. Hand off control to another device during the service.
feature_songLibrary_desc: Manage your church's song collection with lyrics, custom arrangements, and version history. Import songs from ProPresenter.
feature_bible_desc: Browse and search multiple Bible translations. Add verses directly into your presentations.
feature_overlays_desc: Display text or images on top of your slides — perfect for announcements, QR codes, or collection info.
feature_multiUser_desc: Invite team members and manage roles. Each organization has its own song library and presentations.
feature_songTracking_desc: Automatically track which songs are shown during each service — making it easy to compile CCLI reports.
feature_openSource_desc: Completely free and open source. Self-host on your own server.
about1: Gospel Presenter is a free and open-source presentation tool built for churches. It makes it easy to display song lyrics and Bible verses on a second screen or projector during services.
about2: The project is open source. Visit the GitHub repository for instructions on how to self-host.
